moments.title: Halloween countdown
moments.blurb: With just 10 days to go, the UK is gearing up for Halloween with various scare events, theme park fright nights, and family activities planned across the country.

angles.name: Spooky Season Prep
angles.copy: Dust off the cobwebs! Halloween is just 10 days away. Are you ready for the spookiest night of the year? Tell us your plans!

angles.name: Best UK Scare Event
angles.copy: From Alton Towers Scarefest to local haunted trails, the UK is packed with Halloween events. Where's the best place to get a fright this year?

angles.name: Halloween Costume Ideas
angles.copy: Struggling for costume ideas? You've got 10 days! What's your go-to Halloween look, or are you planning something totally new this year?

moments.title: Strictly: Delta Goodrem returns
moments.blurb: Delta Goodrem is set to return to the Strictly Come Dancing dancefloor this weekend (October 24/25) after missing a week due to injury, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe continuing to present the show.

angles.name: Delta's Comeback
angles.copy: She's back! Delta Goodrem is confirmed to return to Strictly this weekend after her injury. Will she pick up where she left off at the top of the leaderboard?

angles.name: New Hosts Verdict
angles.copy: The new Strictly hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are now several weeks in. What's your verdict on the new presenting line-up?

moments.title: I'm A Celeb promo drops
moments.blurb: The first teaser trailer for I'm A Celebrity... Get Me Out Of Here! 2026 has been released, with Ant & Dec putting carol singers through bushtucker trials as anticipation builds for its November return.

angles.name: Jungle Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown to Christmas officially begins when I'm A Celeb is back! The first promo has dropped – who do you want to see in the jungle this year?

angles.name: Ant & Dec's Teaser
angles.copy: Ant & Dec are back with a festive, jungle-themed promo for I'm A Celeb. What's the wildest Bushtucker Trial you've ever seen?

moments.title: Carabao Cup 4th Round
moments.blurb: The Carabao Cup Fourth Round fixtures are scheduled to be played during the week of October 26, featuring a highly anticipated clash between Liverpool and Chelsea.

angles.name: Cup Fever
angles.copy: Carabao Cup 4th Round action kicks off next week! Liverpool vs Chelsea is the standout tie. Who's making it through to the quarter-finals?

angles.name: Big Game Predictions
angles.copy: Liverpool vs Chelsea in the Carabao Cup – that's a Wembley-worthy fixture! What are your predictions for the big game next week?

moments.title: Man City banana protest
moments.blurb: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has encouraged fans to bring inflatable bananas to their next Premier League home game, reviving a 1980s tradition in response to the club's financial breaches and external criticism.

angles.name: Back the Bananas
angles.copy: Inflatable bananas at the Etihad? Man City manager Maresca wants fans to revive the retro protest. What do you make of this show of defiance?

angles.name: Football Fan Protests
angles.copy: From banners to bananas, football fans get creative with protests. What's the most unusual fan protest you've ever seen?

moments.title: Latest UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart was last updated on October 16th, with new tracks making waves and established artists holding strong positions.

angles.name: Chart Talk
angles.copy: The latest Official UK Singles Chart is out! Any surprises, or are your favourite tracks still dominating the airwaves?

angles.name: New Music Rising
angles.copy: Chappell Roan's 'Expectations' remix and other new entries are climbing the charts! What's your pick for the next big hit?

moments.title: Doja Cat turns 31
moments.blurb: American rapper, singer, and songwriter Doja Cat celebrates her 31st birthday today, October 21st.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Doja
angles.copy: Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Doja Cat! What's your favourite track from her? Let us know!

moments.title: Matt Bellamy (Muse) turns 48
moments.blurb: Matt Bellamy, frontman of the rock band Muse, celebrates his 48th birthday today, October 21st.

angles.name: Muse Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to Muse's dynamic frontman, Matt Bellamy! What's your all-time favourite Muse anthem?

moments.title: Shaggy turns 58
moments.blurb: Jamaican-American reggae musician Shaggy, known for hits like 'It Wasn't Me' and 'Boombastic', celebrates his 58th birthday tomorrow, October 22nd.

angles.name: Shaggy's B-Day Eve
angles.copy: It wasn't him... it was his birthday tomorrow! Shaggy turns 58. Get your 'Boombastic' tunes ready for a celebration!

moments.title: Drake turns 40
moments.blurb: Canadian rapper and global superstar Drake celebrates his 40th birthday on October 24th.

angles.name: Drake Hits 40
angles.copy: The 6 God turns 40 on Saturday! Happy Birthday to Drake! Which of his anthems is your all-time favourite?

moments.title: Katy Perry turns 42
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Katy Perry, known for her vibrant hits and spectacular live shows, celebrates her 42nd birthday on October 25th.

angles.name: Katy's Birthday Bash
angles.copy: It's going to be a firework! Katy Perry turns 42 on Sunday. What's your ultimate Katy Perry bop?

moments.title: Simon Le Bon (Duran Duran) turns 68
moments.blurb: Simon Le Bon, the iconic lead singer of new wave legends Duran Duran, celebrates his 68th birthday on October 27th.

angles.name: Duran Duran Legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the one and only Simon Le Bon! What's your favourite Duran Duran track to get you dancing?

moments.title: Grace Slick (Jefferson Airplane) turns 87
moments.blurb: Legendary singer Grace Slick, known for her powerful vocals with Jefferson Airplane and Jefferson Starship, celebrates her 87th birthday on October 30th.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: A true rock legend! Grace Slick of Jefferson Airplane turns 87 this Friday. What's the ultimate psychedelic anthem she sang?

moments.title: New TV: It Gets Worse
moments.blurb: The new A24 comedy 'It Gets Worse', written by and starring Leo Reich, premieres on Channel 4 on October 22nd, with all six episodes available to stream.

angles.name: Must-Watch Comedy
angles.copy: A24's new comedy 'It Gets Worse' lands on Channel 4 tomorrow! Evicted friends, London chaos, and Zadie Smith narrating. Your next binge?

moments.title: Celebrity Traitors S2 continues
moments.blurb: The second season of 'The Celebrity Traitors' on BBC, featuring a new lineup of stars including James Blunt and Maya Jama, continues to air after launching on October 1st.

angles.name: Traitors Drama
angles.copy: Still hooked on The Celebrity Traitors? The drama is unfolding on BBC with James Blunt, Maya Jama and more. Who are your faithfuls and traitors?
